description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten numeral "4" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive or slightly slanted style, with a smooth, continuous stroke that forms the top horizontal line, followed by a vertical line descending from the right side of the top line, and then a small diagonal line extending from the bottom of the vertical line to the left, forming the characteristic shape of the number four. The numeral appears to be drawn with a pen
